messages:
Priya (Docs): quick note 1 i'm assembling a compact FAQ + micro-snippets PR for tiered credits (headers, downgrade behavior, console mapping). plan: 1-paragraph FAQ, 3 tiny snippets (node/python/curl), an express fallback middleware, and a single PromQL grafana example. will open PR this afternoon.

Sam (DevEx): sweet. keep snippets extremely short so they fit in quickstart. show new header names and the fallback to legacy names.

Omar (Eng): prod header names = X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining and X-Redwood-Quota-Window. legacy X-Quota-* still supported. tiny middleware you can paste: ```js
app.use((req,res,next)=>{const r=res.getHeader('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining')||res.getHeader('X-Quota-Remaining');req.quota={remaining:Number(r||0)};next()})
```

Priya (Docs): perfect, i'll inline that. drafting node snippet: ```js
const r = await fetch(url,{headers});
console.log('rem', r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining')||r.headers.get('X-Quota-Remaining'))
```

Sam (DevEx): add python requests example and a curl grep one-liner.

Priya (Docs): python: ```py
r = requests.post(url,json=payload,headers=headers)
print(int(r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining') or 0))
```
curl: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" $URL | grep -i X-Redwood-Quota
```

Ruth (Billing): for downgrades mid-cycle use cautious phrasing: "typically a short (~7 day) grace period; enterprise agreements may differ" and link to the billing playbook. also add a one-line reconciliation tip: use billing exports with the redwood_tokens_consumed_total metric for spot checks.

Priya (Docs): adjusted language and added the reconciliation hint + billing link. DocsBot: PR checklist reminder 1 changelog entry + migration note + billing crosslink required.

Sam (DevEx): grafana PromQL suggestion for 7d consumption by customer tier (exclude internal/test): ```promql
sum by(customer_tier) (increase(redwood_tokens_consumed_total{env=\"prod\", customer_type!~\"internal|test\"}[7d]))
```
Legend: {{customer_tier}}

Omar (Eng): looks good. recommend setting panel time range to 7d and adding the customer_type filter as shown. i'll validate on staging.

Priya (Docs): thanks all 1 i'll open the PR at 1765558000 and tag @Sam, @Omar, @Ruth for review. small docs like this cut tickets. :tada:
